title: Affine to global torsion cohomological dimension reduction
statement: The affine bound in degrees above d + c implies that a finite-type K-scheme of dimension at most d has Subsingleton (H^q(X,F)) for every torsion abelian etale sheaf F and every q with 2*d + c < q.

proof.text: Apply comparison with the Zariski site to an injective resolution. Exact inverse image makes direct image preserve injectives. The resulting Grothendieck spectral sequence has ordinary etale cohomology as abutment. Stalks of the higher direct image are filtered colimits of open-restriction cohomology. Use the supplied hAffine on a cofinal basis of affine neighbourhoods, whose dimensions are bounded by d and whose restricted sheaves remain torsion. This kills higher direct images above d+c; Grothendieck vanishing kills Zariski degree above d, so first-quadrant convergence and its finite filtration give zero in total degrees above 2*d+c.

      [QuasiCompact b] [IsAffine Y] (hY : topologicalKrullDim Y ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞))

      d + c < n → Subsingleton (Sheaf.H G n))
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (hF : F.IsTorsion) (q : ℕ)
    (hq : 2 * d + c < q) : Subsingleton (Sheaf.H F q)
